g.title: IE_QSP
g.text: The MIC is measured on 10^5 CFU/mL of log-phase planktonic cells in broth. The vegetation presents 10^10 CFU/g of stationary-phase cells behind a 2-5 mm AVASCULAR diffusion barrier.
Every peculiarity of IE therapy — 6-week durations, bactericidal-only regimens, combinations, the surgical indications, the ceiling on vancomycin exposure — is a consequence of that mismatch.
IE is a GEOMETRY problem wearing the clothes of a susceptibility problem.
